channel.title: MedTechDive – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MedTechDive – Bias and Credibility (medtechdive.com)

item.title: Labcorp closes purchase of New York pathology reference lab assets
item.description: The deal, which will see Labcorp run 12 patient service centers, is part of the company’s ongoing efforts to expand through acquisitions.

item.title: FTC creates healthcare task force
item.description: The task force will share resources and coordinate enforcement across the Federal Trade Commission’s disparate bureaus to better address consumer protection and competition issues in healthcare, the FTC commissioner said.

item.title: SS Innovations ramps up in telesurgery; XCath robot treats stroke remotely
item.description: SS Innovations’ robot won approvals to perform telesurgery in Indonesia and the Philippines, while the first remote robotic mechanical thrombectomy to treat stroke was performed with XCath’s system.

item.title: GE HealthCare wins FDA nod for photon-counting CT technology
item.description: The 510(k) decision clears the company to challenge Siemens Healthineers for an emerging part of the CT imaging sector.

item.title: Medtronic to distribute Merit Medical’s low back pain treatment
item.description: Merit’s basivertebral nerve ablation system is expected to round out Medtronic’s pain treatment options.

item.title: Endologix to close production facility, lay off 31 people
item.description: The company acquired the facility in the PQ Bypass takeover it struck in the aftermath of its bankruptcy filing.

item.title: Philips wins FDA clearance for imaging device developed with Edwards
item.description: The system uses AI to optimize the placement of Edwards’ mitral valve repair device.

item.title: Stryker restores most manufacturing after cyberattack
item.description: The medtech company has been working to restore manufacturing, ordering and shipping operations since it was hit by a cyberattack on March 11.

item.title: Glucotrack plans US trial of implantable glucose monitor this year
item.description: Glucotrack plans to file for an investigational device exemption in the second quarter, with hopes of starting a trial in the second half of 2026.

item.title: Medtronic wins FDA clearance for robot in cranial, ENT surgeries
item.description: The surgical navigation and robotics system is part of the company’s push to expand its share of the $15 billion cranial and spinal technologies market.

item.title: Boston Scientific posts positive stroke prevention data for Watchman
item.description: The company said it will seek an expanded indication for the left atrial appendage closure device after it met all safety and efficacy goals in the closely watched CHAMPION-AF study.

item.title: Medtronic to study renal denervation combined with PCI
item.description: Medtronic detailed plans to further study the blood pressure treatment while releasing additional data from the SPYRAL HTN trials that showed the procedure reduced hypertensive emergencies.

item.title: Medtronic wins CE mark for OmniaSecure defibrillation lead
item.description: The device maker designed the lead to have the safety benefits of small-diameter devices without sacrificing durability.

item.title: Whoop raises $575M, adds Abbott as strategic investor
item.description: Whoop, the maker of a wearable wristband, plans to use the funds for global expansion and personalized health features.

item.title: ‘Cracks show’ as CDRH staff contend with heavy workloads
item.description: Former device leaders said a culture of “fear and anxiety” has driven experienced staff from the Food and Drug Administration. An overburdened workforce has affected communications from the agency.
